about.title: About
about.description: Systems-first engineering: contracts, queues, and data paths you can operate.
about.p1: Backend & Integration Engineer focused on scalable systems and financial technology. I design backends in Laravel, Go, and Python, pairing distributed systems with Kafka and PostgreSQL for throughput you can reason about in incidents—not only in diagrams.
about.p2: Shipped work spans ERP customization, real-time operations, and integrations over REST and SOAP, with automation that replaces fragile spreadsheets. Today I build payment infrastructure that connects PIX with blockchain settlement (USDT on TRON), prioritizing ledger integrity, async processing, and backends that stay boring under load.
